stem: What was one reason Japan attacked the U.S. naval base at Pearl Harbor?

options.label: F
options.text: The U.S. strategy of island hopping had disturbed Pacific trade routes.

options.label: G
options.text: The Japanese naval fleet had been defeated at the Battle of Midway.

options.label: H
options.text: Japanese Americans had been relocated to internment camps.

options.label: J
options.text: U.S. trade sanctions had caused shortages of oil, gas, and rubber.
